Council Meetings

The Council meetings for 2026 will commence at 3pm on the third Wednesday of each month except January.  All meetings will be held in the Cuballing CWA Hall at 189 Campbell St, Cuballing. 

The meeting dates are as follows:

  • Annual General Meeting of Electors - 4.30pm Wednesday 4 February 2026
  • 18 February 2026
  • 18 March 2026 
  • 15 April 2026
  • 20 May 2026
  • 17 June 2026
  • 15 July 2026
  • 19 August 2026
  • 23 September 2026
  • 21 October 2026
  • 18 November 2026
  • 16 December 2026

All meetings are open to the public and will commence with 15 minute public question time.

Council Meeting Agendas and Minutes can be found here.
